content_html:
watched #DevaDas : it has a normal basic story plot…..and basic execution, you neither feel as if you are watching a great movie nor you feel as you are watching a bad movie!!! The director tried to balance between a comercial and message movie…..However the strength of this movie lies in the perfect star cast where the director successed in utilizing the natural acting skills of Nani and superb screen presence of Nag which has proved to be the game changer for this movie. Coming to Nani….Man what an actor!!! he makes it look easy with his cute expressions _/\_ coming to Nag his screen presence is enough and his fitness and handsome levels are outstanding!!! looks like while Nani was busy in taking care of the acting part of the movie….Nag has shouldered the responsibility of Glamour part!!! Nothing much for the Heroines….

Songs wise its again an average…..with evety song being neither good nor bad!!! However the movie has very impressive BGM…..Overall its a Good Time Pass movie with good laughs for every 3-5 mins only if you put your logical brain at home
